solutions.title: Sort by start and track overlap
solutions.strategy: Sort by start and maintain the current intersection end for balloons covered by the same arrow.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The scan stores constant state, while runtime sorting may allocate auxiliary memory.

solutions.title: Sort by end greedy
solutions.strategy: Shoot at the end of the first uncovered interval, then skip every interval containing that shot.

timeComplexity.explanation: Sorting by end dominates the linear scan.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The scan stores constant state, while runtime sorting may allocate auxiliary memory.
